summary: Glass House Brands filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a Canadian continuous-disclosure material-change report) disclosing an auditor change under NI 51-102 Section 4.11. Effective September 11, 2026, predecessor auditor Macias Gini O'Connell LLP resigned at the Company's request and BDO USA, P.C. was appointed successor, approved by the audit committee and board. The notice states no modified opinions for the two most recent fiscal years and no reportable events under NI 51-102. Both auditors furnished consent letters. This is a routine governance disclosure, not a special situation; watch for any future restatement or disclosure-control issues.
